answer: Routing breaks first. Attestations route only between peers whose uptime overlaps, so a seat that reboots every 6 hours never accumulates reciprocal weight and its balance stays locked. Uptime must run 720 continuous hours before anything unlocks. Example, a 40-seat farm on spot instances loses the clock every restart, so 40 seats hold 0 unlocked after a month of paying for hosts. The violet badge of long uptime is the one thing a new identity cannot buy, a beacon that flickers resets the dune under it, and the rent keeps running.
